# Behavioural corpus for pre-bash-guard.sh, run by `bash scripts/doctor.sh --hooks`.
#
# Format: WANT|command      WANT is DENY or ALLOW. Lines starting with # are ignored.
#
# The ALLOW half is not padding. A guard that fires on ordinary work gets switched off, and then
# the DENY half protects nothing — so a false positive here fails the check exactly like a hole.
# Add a case in BOTH halves whenever the guard learns a new command.
#
# Not covered here: cases whose verdict depends on the branch that happens to be checked out
# (bare `git push -f` resolves the current branch). doctor.sh checks those separately.
#
# The branch-creation cases below DO depend on the working directory — the guard resolves which
# repo a command acts on. doctor.sh runs this corpus with cwd pinned to the orchestrator root so
# the verdicts are deterministic; running the guard by hand from elsewhere will differ, correctly.

# ── destroying what cannot be re-fetched ─────────────────────────────────────
DENY|rm -rf /Users/someone/Desktop
DENY|rm -rf /Users/someone/repos/fpl-backend/node_modules/../../..
DENY|rm -rf ../fpl-backend/node_modules/../../..
DENY|rm -rf ./node_modules/../..
DENY|dropdb fpl
DENY|psql -c "DROP DATABASE fpl"
DENY|psql -c "TRUNCATE player_price_history"
DENY|psql -c "TRUNCATE TABLE public.player_ownership_history"
DENY|psql -c "DELETE FROM player_price_history WHERE 1=1"
DENY|docker compose down -v
DENY|docker compose down --volumes
DENY|git clean -xdf

# ── force-push to a default branch, all three spellings of "force" ───────────
DENY|git push --force origin main
DENY|git push origin +main
DENY|git push origin +HEAD:main
DENY|git push --force-with-lease origin refs/heads/master

# ── ordinary work: every one of these must pass untouched ────────────────────
ALLOW|rm -rf node_modules
ALLOW|rm -rf ../fpl-backend/node_modules
ALLOW|rm -rf ../../fpl-frontend/.next
ALLOW|rm -rf "$ORCH/.dev-logs"
ALLOW|rm -rf .next dist coverage
ALLOW|rm -rf /tmp/scratch-thing
ALLOW|pnpm build && rm -rf dist
ALLOW|git push -u origin HEAD
ALLOW|git push origin feat/main-menu
ALLOW|git push --force origin feat/main-menu
ALLOW|git push --force origin develop-ui
ALLOW|git switch main && git reset --hard origin/main
ALLOW|git clean -fd
ALLOW|docker compose down
ALLOW|docker compose up -d
ALLOW|pnpm sync:fpl
ALLOW|pnpm sync:fpl -- --full
ALLOW|pnpm prisma migrate status
ALLOW|pnpm prisma migrate dev
ALLOW|psql -c "SELECT * FROM player_price_history LIMIT 5"
ALLOW|gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
ALLOW|bash scripts/doctor.sh --hooks
ALLOW|lsof -nP -i :4000 -i :5001
ALLOW|pnpm test

# ── the orchestrator does not branch ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Verdicts below assume cwd = fpl-orchestrator, which doctor.sh pins.
DENY|git switch -c feat/thing
DENY|git switch --create chore/thing
DENY|git checkout -b fix/thing
DENY|git branch feat/thing
DENY|git checkout -B fix/thing
# A create hidden behind another segment still counts. Each segment is judged on its own and
# resolves its own -C, so a later `-C <sibling>` cannot launder an earlier bare create.
DENY|git switch -c feat/x && git -C ../fpl-backend status
DENY|git status; git checkout -b feat/x
# ...but branching a SIBLING from a session sitting here is ordinary work.
ALLOW|git -C ../fpl-backend switch -c feat/12-thing
ALLOW|git -C ../fpl-frontend checkout -b fix/13-thing
# ...and so is every read, every delete, and getting back onto main.
ALLOW|git switch main
ALLOW|git checkout main
ALLOW|git branch -d feat/thing
ALLOW|git branch -D feat/thing
ALLOW|git branch --show-current
ALLOW|git branch -a
ALLOW|git branch
ALLOW|git checkout -- .
ALLOW|git checkout main -- orchestration/workflow.md
# The false positive that forced this rule to be rewritten: WRITING the rule down. Every skill and
# workflow.md spell out the commands above, so a line-wide match denies its own documentation.
# Only a segment whose FIRST token is `git` is a command; prose and heredoc bodies are not.
ALLOW|echo "workflow.md step 2: git switch -c <type>/<issue>-<slug>" >> notes.md
